title: Masoon Audio Mirror Manifest v1
description: Playback manifest for a static mirror, with a per-surah package index and optional checksum sidecar.

provider.description: Adapter for a self-hosted static mirror.

base_url.description: HTTPS base URL. Append the expanded per-unit path template to locate a file.

checksums_url.description: HTTPS URL of a sidecar mapping per-unit object keys to their SHA-256 digests.

segments_available.description: Whether verified timing segments are available for the exact audio files.

surah_packages.description: Available per-surah packages. The index can be partial or empty.

UrlTemplate.description: Per-unit path template. Supports {work}, {unit}, {work:03}, and {unit:03}. The :03 suffix pads the coordinate to three digits.

License.description: Source attribution and terms metadata. Confirm permissions for the intended distribution with the applicable rights holders.

ayah_count.description: Number of per-ayah files in the package. Cross-check with the selected corpus index.

package_url.description: HTTPS URL of the descriptor listing per-ayah objects, sizes, and checksums.

byte_size.description: Total bytes of the constituent audio files.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string formed by joining the per-ayah lowercase SHA-256 digests in ascending ayah order, separated by one newline.

PackageIndexEntry.description: Descriptor reference for a surah package made from the original per-ayah files.
